title.narrative: Stop Violence Now Against Women and Girls

description.narrative: The overall goal of the project is to contribute to the fight against GBV in the crisis-affected North-West region of Cameroon. There are two Specific Objectives: 1. To strengthen protection response to GBV and empower survivors. 2. To increase community resilience against GBV in the North-West region.
